battleFormations.name: Warhost
battleFormations.effect: Martial Grace: Gain 1 extra Battle Focus token per round; Swift as the Wind gives +1" extra Move; Agile Manoeuvres that use a D6 roll get +1 to that roll.

battleFormations.name: Windrider Host
battleFormations.effect: Ride the Wind: MOUNTED/VYPER units can deploy in Reserves; select units (1/2/3 by battle size) can retreat to Strategic Reserves at the end of the opponent's turn. WINDRIDERS gain the BATTLELINE keyword.

battleFormations.name: Guardian Battlehost
battleFormations.effect: Defend at All Costs: DIRE AVENGER/GUARDIAN/SUPPORT WEAPON/WAR WALKER attacks gain +1 to Hit if either unit is near an objective marker.

battleFormations.name: Spirit Conclave
battleFormations.effect: Shepherds of the Dead: If an ASURYANI PSYKER is destroyed, the enemy gains a 'Vengeful Dead' token; WRAITH CONSTRUCT attacks against tokened units gain +1 to Hit and +1 to Wound. WRAITHBLADES/WRAITHGUARD gain the BATTLELINE keyword.

artefacts.name: Phoenix Gem
artefacts.effect: [ASURYANI only] The first time the bearer is destroyed, roll one D6 at the end of the phase: on a 2+ set it back up on the battlefield with its full wounds.

artefacts.name: Timeless Strategist
artefacts.effect: [ASURYANI only] While the bearer is on the battlefield, gain 1 extra Battle Focus token per round.

artefacts.name: Gift of Foresight
artefacts.effect: [ASURYANI only] Once per round, gain a free Command Re-roll (0CP) for the bearer's unit.

artefacts.name: Psychic Destroyer
artefacts.effect: [ASURYANI PSYKER only] Add 1 to the Damage characteristic of ranged Psychic weapons equipped by the bearer.

artefacts.name: Firstdrawn Blade
artefacts.effect: [ASURYANI MOUNTED only] The bearer's unit gains the Scouts 9" ability.

artefacts.name: Mirage Field
artefacts.effect: [ASURYANI MOUNTED only] Attacks against the bearer's unit suffer -1 to Hit.

artefacts.name: Seersight Strike
artefacts.effect: [ASURYANI MOUNTED PSYKER only] The bearer's Psychic weapons gain [ANTI-MONSTER 2+] and [ANTI-VEHICLE 2+].

artefacts.name: Echoes of Ulthanesh
artefacts.effect: [ASURYANI MOUNTED only] Each Command phase, spend 1CP to return a destroyed model on a 5+ (+1 outside deployment zone, +1 more in enemy deployment zone).

artefacts.name: Light of Clarity
artefacts.effect: [SPIRITSEER only] Boosts a nearby Wraith unit's Objective Control (+1 Infantry / +3 Monster).

artefacts.name: Stave of Kurnous
artefacts.effect: [SPIRITSEER only] A nearby Wraith unit's Critical Wounds gain the [PRECISION] ability.

artefacts.name: Rune of Mists
artefacts.effect: [SPIRITSEER only] A nearby Wraith unit gains Benefit of Cover against long-range attacks.

artefacts.name: Higher Duty
artefacts.effect: [SPIRITSEER only] Reactive 6" move when an enemy ends a move within 8" of the bearer.

artefacts.name: Craftworld's Champion
artefacts.effect: [ASURYANI only] The bearer has an Objective Control characteristic of 5.

artefacts.name: Ethereal Pathway
artefacts.effect: [ASURYANI only] Up to 2 Guardians units gain the Infiltrators ability.

artefacts.name: Protector of the Paths
artefacts.effect: [ASURYANI only] Free Fire Overwatch once per round; improved hit thresholds near objectives.

artefacts.name: Breath of Vaul
artefacts.effect: [ASURYANI only] Re-roll flamer attack count / fusion gun Damage for the bearer's led Storm Guardians.

armyRules.name: Battle Focus
armyRules.effect: Gain Battle Focus tokens each round (2/4/6 by battle size). Spend to trigger Agile Manoeuvres: Swift as the Wind (+2" Move), Flitting Shadows (immune to Fire Overwatch), Star Engines (Vehicle Advance gains [ASSAULT]), Sudden Strike (Pile-in/Consolidate +3"), Opportunity Seized (move D6+1" when an enemy Falls Back from Engagement Range), Fade Back (move D6+1" after being shot).

armyRules.name: Strands of Fate
armyRules.effect: Roll 6D6 at the start of the battle; you can re-roll all remaining dice (losing one die each time) until satisfied. Remaining dice form a Fate dice pool; substitute for any Advance, Battle-shock, Charge, Damage, Hit, Save, or Wound roll once per phase per die used.
